I am an Associate Professor of Behaviour Analysis at the University of South Wales. My work focuses on behavioural interventions and how they operate in real-world contexts, spanning areas such as learning disabilities, language development, gambling, and meta-science, with an emphasis on transparent and reproducible research practices.

I teach across undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, and Behaviour Analysis.

I am an Editorial Board member for *Perspectives on Behavior Science* and the *Journal of the Experimental Analysis of Behaviour*, and Co-Chair of the Teaching Skills sub-group within the Sharland Foundation Developmental Disabilities Applied Behavioral Research Impact Network.
